# Collaborative Construction, LLC

> A residential and commercial general contractor based in East Falmouth,
> Massachusetts, serving Cape Cod and the Islands and the South Shore.
> Motto: Experience, Quality, Trust.

## Contact

- Email: collaborativeconstructiongc@gmail.com
- Phone: (508) 440-6981
- Location: East Falmouth, MA 02536
- Website: https://collaborativeconstructionllc.com/

## Who runs it

Wesleigh Behn, Owner and Founder. A Massachusetts native with over 30 years of
experience in both residential and commercial construction. He holds a
Bachelor's degree from Boston University and completed postgraduate studies at
the Boston Architectural Center, and has maintained an active Massachusetts
Construction Supervisor License (CSL) since 2000.

## Services

- New residential construction, additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations
- Kitchen and bathroom remodels
- Commercial construction and tenant fit-outs
- Owner's Project Management: representing the owner through pre-construction,
  design, bidding, and construction
- Clerk of the Works: on-site oversight verifying work matches the drawings,
  specifications, and schedule
- Construction Advisory: independent review of contracts, budgets, bids, and
  schedules for owners

## Service area

Cape Cod and the Islands, and the South Shore of Massachusetts.
